cases.disposition_reason: showcase --page pickers opens Pickers through parse_page and App::open_page in src/bin/showcase/main.rs. The screen is Overlays › Pickers with Open quickly at 120×40. That size is not below TooSmall::MIN_WIDTH or MIN_HEIGHT in src/widgets/too_small.rs, so render in src/shell/app.rs paints the page instead of Terminal too small. finish sends Ctrl+Q. QuitKeys::classify in src/ui/leave.rs returns LeaveKey::Quit for Ctrl+Q, and the process exits 0.
cases.return_path: The Pickers screen stays up, then finish sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: TooSmall::applies in src/widgets/too_small.rs is true when width is below 72 or height is below 20. render paints Terminal too small and Need 72×20, have {w}×{h}. shell::render in src/shell/app.rs sets shell.too_small and paints that screen instead of the page. KeyRouter::paste and the too_small arm of once in src/shell/router.rs consume paste and non-quit keys, so each draft is entered before the shrink. No binary overrides the minimum: showcase too_small is TooSmall::new(BRAND) in src/bin/showcase/app.rs, tablepro is TooSmall::new("TablePro") in src/bin/tablepro/app.rs, holla is TooSmall::new(BRAND_PADDED) in src/bin/holla/app.rs, and jackin is TooSmall::new(BRAND_PADDED) in src/bin/jackin/app.rs. 71×20 and 72×19 paint the too-small title and that size's Need line and hide the draft. 72×20 clears the title and shows the UI. Showcase Input::Resize in src/bin/showcase/app.rs returns Outcome::Changed and does not clear page or layer state. On forms, FormDraftX02 is absent while too small and present again at 72×20 and at the src/shell/reach.rs sizes above the minimum (80×24, 100×25, 106×29, 120×40, 160×50). 40×12 and 60×18 are too small. The Delete branch? dialog from src/bin/showcase/pages/dialogs.rs stays open at 72×20 with feat/rate-limit and cannot be undone. On taskrunner, 72×20 hides the log because the log slot is below the pipe in src/bin/showcase/pages/taskrunner.rs, and the visible proof is Pipeline · running. At 120×40 the log still shows Pipeline started. The checkpoint opens the quick picker, types schema, and keeps schema.rs, src/db/schema.rs, and All · Tab scope after growth. Cargo.toml stays filtered out. The 80×24 frame is captured before the return to 120×40, and the wide frame is that restored picker. Picker::on_other_key in src/widgets/picker.rs returns Consumed for Ctrl+Q, so Esc clears the query and a second Esc cancels before finish. Tablepro, holla --scenario first-use, and jackin --scenario first-use each paint Terminal too small at 71×20 and their own UI at 72×20 (Filter connections, Analyze disk usage, and Knock, knock, operator.) while the process is still running. Those three use kill_child. Launch::new leaves the clock off.
cases.action_sequence: On tablepro, holla --scenario first-use, and jackin --scenario first-use, resize to 71×20 and then to 72×20. On showcase --page dialogs, open Delete branch, then resize through 71×20, 72×19, and 72×20. On showcase --page taskrunner, run the pipeline, resize through those sizes, and return to 120×40. On showcase --page forms, commit FormDraftX02, resize through 71×20 and 72×19, restore 72×20, then walk 40×12, 60×18, 80×24, 100×25, 106×29, 120×40, and 160×50. On showcase --page pickers, open Open quickly and type schema at 120×40. Resize through 71×20 and 72×19, restore 72×20, capture 80×24, then capture the restored 120×40 frame. Esc clears the query, Esc closes the picker, then finish.
cases.expected_results: Below 72×20 the screen contains Terminal too small and Need 72×20, have {w}×{h}, and the draft is hidden. At 72×20 and above, the too-small title is gone and the same draft, dialog, or running pipeline is visible. The narrow checkpoint is 80×24 with schema.rs still shown. The wide checkpoint is the restored 120×40 picker. Tablepro shows Filter connections, holla shows Analyze disk usage, and jackin shows Knock, knock, operator. The process is still running after each restore.
cases.forbidden_effects: The too-small title remains at 72×20 or larger. A draft, the delete dialog, or the pipeline log is lost after growth. The narrow baseline is captured after the terminal returns to 120×40.
